rules: The AI selects a card by kit_id from this catalog. It never writes, edits or extends a card at call time.
script_lines are read verbatim by the agent. display_steps are what the app shows.
Wording here is original EchoHawk wording. The authority is cited and linked; Red Cross and AHA materials are not reproduced.
Medical cards ship labeled pending qualified medical review. A missing or unapproved card never delays a transfer.

kits.title: Safe Lighting During a Power Outage
kits.authority: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (power outage safety guidance)
kits.permissions_status: CDC content is public domain; attribution given; no endorsement implied; wording is original
script_lines: I can walk you through safe lighting while the power is out.
Find a flashlight, headlamp, or battery lantern first, and check for spare batteries or a charged power bank.
Use battery lights instead of candles or anything with an open flame.
Never run a gas generator, grill, or camp stove inside your home or garage.
If someone in the home depends on powered medical equipment, follow your backup power plan now and tell me so I can flag it.
display_steps: Flashlight, headlamp or battery lantern first. Check spare batteries or a power bank.
Battery light, not candles or open flames.
Never run a generator, grill or camp stove indoors or in the garage.
Powered medical equipment at home? Start your backup plan and tell the line.
kits.source_panel: General safety information drawn from CDC power outage guidance, in our own words. Not a substitute for emergency services. Reviewed 2026-10-17.
script_lines_es: Puedo guiarle para iluminar su casa de forma segura mientras no hay luz.
Primero busque una linterna, una lámpara de cabeza o un farol de pilas, y revise si tiene pilas de repuesto o una batería portátil cargada.
Use luces de pilas en lugar de velas o cualquier cosa con llama abierta.
Nunca use un generador de gasolina, una parrilla o una estufa de campamento dentro de la casa o del garaje.
Si alguien en la casa depende de un equipo médico eléctrico, siga ahora su plan de energía de respaldo y dígamelo para marcarlo.
display_steps_es: Primero linterna, lámpara de cabeza o farol de pilas. Revise pilas de repuesto o batería portátil.
Luz de pilas, no velas ni llamas abiertas.
Nunca use generador, parrilla o estufa de campamento adentro ni en el garaje.
¿Equipo médico eléctrico en casa? Inicie su plan de respaldo y avise a la línea.
kits.translation_status: es: team translation of the original English wording, not reviewed by a certified translator

kits.title: Life-Threatening Bleeding, While Help Is Coming
kits.authority: American Red Cross (severe bleeding first aid) and American College of Surgeons STOP THE BLEED, as references
kits.permissions_status: Original wording; Red Cross and ACS materials are referenced, not reproduced
contraindications: No improvised tourniquet instruction is given.
This card fires alongside a transfer to a dispatcher and never instead of one.
script_lines: I'm connecting you to a dispatcher right now. While I do, keep firm, steady pressure directly on the wound with a clean cloth or whatever you have.
Press hard and don't lift to check. Keep the pressure on until help arrives.
If you have someone with you, have them watch the person and tell you if they become less responsive.
display_steps: Firm, steady pressure directly on the wound with a clean cloth or clothing.
Press hard. Don't lift to check. Hold until help arrives.
Have someone watch the person for changes and tell the dispatcher.
kits.source_panel: General first-aid information in our own words, with the American Red Cross and STOP THE BLEED as references. Pending qualified medical review. Not a substitute for emergency services.
script_lines_es: Le estoy conectando con un despachador ahora mismo. Mientras tanto, mantenga presión firme y constante directamente sobre la herida con un paño limpio o lo que tenga a mano.
Presione fuerte y no levante para revisar. Mantenga la presión hasta que llegue la ayuda.
Si hay alguien con usted, pídale que observe a la persona y le avise si responde menos.
display_steps_es: Presión firme y constante directamente sobre la herida con un paño limpio o ropa.
Presione fuerte. No levante para revisar. Sostenga hasta que llegue la ayuda.
Que alguien observe a la persona por cambios y se lo diga al despachador.
kits.translation_status: es: team translation of the original English wording, not reviewed by a certified translator

kits.title: Build My Emergency Bag
kits.permissions_status: Federal preparedness guidance; original wording; graphics not reused
script_lines: Let's build your emergency bag in five minutes.
Water for everyone for three days, and food that doesn't need cooking.
A flashlight, a battery or hand-crank radio, spare batteries, and a phone charger or power bank.
A basic first aid kit, your medications, and copies of important documents.
Write down two emergency contacts and a meeting place, and put the bag where you can grab it on the way out.
display_steps: Water: three days for each person. Food that needs no cooking.
Flashlight, battery or hand-crank radio, spare batteries, power bank.
First aid kit, medications, copies of important documents.
Two emergency contacts and a meeting place, written down.
Keep the bag by the door you'd leave from.
kits.source_panel: Based on Ready.gov's emergency supply checklist, in our own words. Reviewed 2026-10-17.
script_lines_es: Vamos a armar su mochila de emergencia en cinco minutos.
Agua para todos para tres días, y comida que no necesite cocinarse.
Una linterna, un radio de pilas o de manivela, pilas de repuesto y un cargador de teléfono o batería portátil.
Un botiquín básico, sus medicamentos y copias de documentos importantes.
Anote dos contactos de emergencia y un punto de reunión, y deje la mochila donde pueda tomarla al salir.
display_steps_es: Agua: tres días por persona. Comida que no necesite cocinarse.
Linterna, radio de pilas o de manivela, pilas de repuesto, batería portátil.
Botiquín, medicamentos, copias de documentos importantes.
Dos contactos de emergencia y un punto de reunión, por escrito.
Deje la mochila junto a la puerta por la que saldría.
